bundle.shortDescription: Map your VRChat friends, mutuals and circles
bundle.longDescription: Draws your VRChat friends as cards and a graph, links people who are friends with each other, lets you sort them into overlapping circles and compare friend lists that others share with you. Uses your own VRChat sign-in and updates live.
